title: Encrypted Messaging Risk Calculator - Check Your Privacy Score
metaDescription: Calculate your messaging privacy risk score. Assess your encrypted messaging habits and get personalized recommendations for secure communication.
description: Evaluate your messaging privacy risks and discover vulnerabilities in your communication habits. Get a personalized risk score and actionable recommendations to improve your encrypted messaging security across Signal, WhatsApp, Telegram, and other platforms.

formula: let appRisk = 0; switch(primaryApp) { case 'signal': appRisk = 5; break; case 'whatsapp': appRisk = 25; break; case 'imessage': appRisk = 30; break; case 'telegram': appRisk = 35; break; case 'sms': appRisk = 80; break; default: appRisk = 70; } let backupRisk = backupEnabled === 'yes' ? 30: (backupEnabled === 'unsure' ? 20: 0); let groupRisk = Math.min(groupChats * 1.5, 30); let contentRisk = {'never': 0, 'rarely': 10, 'sometimes': 25, 'often': 40}[sensitiveContent] || 25; let disappearingRisk = {'always': 0, 'sometimes': 10, 'no': 20, 'unavailable': 15}[disappearingMessages] || 20; let contactRisk = contactsOnInsecure * 0.3; let totalRisk = Math.min(appRisk + backupRisk + groupRisk + contentRisk + disappearingRisk + contactRisk, 100); let grade = totalRisk <= 20 ? 'A': totalRisk <= 40 ? 'B': totalRisk <= 60 ? 'C': totalRisk <= 80 ? 'D': 'F'; let concerns = []; if(appRisk >= 30) concerns.push('Insecure messaging app'); if(backupRisk >= 20) concerns.push('Cloud backup exposure'); if(contentRisk >= 25) concerns.push('Sensitive content sharing'); if(contactRisk >= 25) concerns.push('Insecure contacts'); let primaryConcern = concerns[0] || 'Metadata collection'; { riskScore: Math.round(totalRisk), riskGrade: grade, primaryConcern: primaryConcern }

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates messaging privacy risks based on app security, backup practices, group chat exposure, content sensitivity, disappearing message usage, and contact security habits. Scores range from 0 (most secure) to 100 (highest risk).
tips: Switch to Signal for maximum privacy - it's the gold standard for encrypted messaging
Disable cloud backups for messaging apps to prevent government and hacker access
Enable disappearing messages for sensitive conversations to limit data retention
Use a privacy-focused browser when accessing web versions of messaging apps for added privacy
Regularly audit your group chats and leave unnecessary ones to reduce exposure
